purpose: Engineering speed and numerical equivalence only; no model fitting or official test access
records: Same 16 fit ECGs selected without labels for the completed parallel pilot
precision: float64 / complex128; no fast math; CUDA FMA disabled
algorithm: Frozen VMD settings and restart-from-initialization retry limits; CPU FFT and descriptors, GPU iterative updates
gpu_kernel: One 256-thread block per lead; at most 64 iterations per kernel launch
variants: CPU serial reference on first two pilot records, four leads per batch
GPU four-lead batches on first two records
CPU eight-worker baseline on all 16 records, four leads per batch
GPU all 192 leads batched together on all 16 records
timing: Synchronized wall time includes VMD retries, transfers, reconstruction and CPU descriptors; source loading, reference checks and artifact writes excluded; CPU pool startup included and reported
startup: Record GPU context initialization and synthetic compilation/warmup separately

checks.iterations: Require exact per-lead final iteration counts and retry limits; log every attempt
checks.feature_names: Require exact names and record/lead ordering
checks.mismatch_policy: Retain mismatch diagnostics, report failure, do not promote GPU output into the production run

full_extraction: Keep existing CPU extraction stopped during timings; no automatic backend switch or full GPU launch
output: Separate directory with status, manifest, timings, per-record diagnostics, predictions_available=false and retained failure traces
